name: Emergency broadcast
description: A fictional emergency alert taking over the screen like an old set switching on: a red header bar, a stark warning wiping on, instructions under it and a blinking footer, under a slow red pulse, then the set switching off.

controls.d: Stay indoors. Cover every window. Do not answer the door, whoever it sounds like.

texts.name: message
texts.label: Message
texts.default: Stay indoors. Cover every window. Do not answer the door, whoever it sounds like.

name: Shadow hands
description: The shadows of long-fingered hands reaching in over a picture from the edges of the frame one after another, fingers spread, closing on nothing and drawing back.

name: Creeping dark
description: Darkness with tendril edges slowly closing in from the corners of a picture and drawing back, recoiling from the pointer while it hovers as if from a torch.

name: Spirit orbs
description: Pale translucent orbs over a picture, like the ones that turn up in flash photos of haunted houses, drifting like dust and every so often darting off in a streak before drifting on.

name: Ectoplasm wisps
description: Glowing green trails of ectoplasm spiralling in out of the dark towards the pointer while it hovers, or a point wandering the frame, each fading as it arrives and another rising in its place.

name: Trail cam
description: A picture as an infrared trail camera's stills, a new grainy grey shot every second or so under its flash, with the date and time stamped along the bottom, and a figure in a few of the shots, closer each time.

name: Possessed text
description: A title that something takes hold of: its letters writhe, twist and float up out of line behind a blood-red haze, then snap back into place all at once as if nothing happened.

name: Eyes in the dark
description: Pairs of glowing eyes opening one after another in the dark, blinking and watching the pointer, snapping shut when it comes near and opening again somewhere else.

name: Ghost apparition
description: A translucent figure fading in over a picture as it cools and darkens, flickering, hanging there with hollow eyes and wisps trailing from its hem, then fading away; turn on Double exposure to show a second picture inside it. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Presence.

name: Signal lost
description: A live feed that stutters and freezes, breaks into blocky corruption that smears across the frozen frame, shows a hidden picture through the broken blocks, then cuts to static and comes back as if nothing happened. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Moment.

name: Night vision camcorder
description: A picture through a camcorder's night-vision mode: amplified green phosphor with heavy grain in the shadows, blooming highlights and a dark tube vignette, where pairs of eyes catch the infrared light and shine back out of the dark now and then.

name: VHS tracking
description: A picture on a cursed tape: the image warping as the tape stretches, a band of tracking noise rolling up through it, head-switching tear along the bottom, colour bleeding to the right and a camcorder's REC and clock burned in.

name: Redact box
description: Black redaction bars drawn line by line over part of a screenshot or video, then a REDACTED stamp slammed on top.

name: Redaction bars
description: Black marker bars drawn one after another over lines of a picture, like a redacted document, then wiped away.

name: Scramble censor
description: Part of a picture or video broken into shuffled, flipped blocks with digital noise, reshuffling several times a second.

name: Blur censor
description: Part of a picture or video blurred beyond recognition, as for a face or a screen, or everything but it blurred for focus.

name: Pixelate censor
description: Part of a picture or video hidden behind big mosaic blocks, as for a face or a number plate, the blocks shimmering like a live censor.

name: Rolodex
description: Cards on a rolodex spindle flipping down one after another, each showing a figure and its label, for rotating stats, quotes or names.

controls.d: signed up this month, on the App Store, over the last year, and counting

texts.name: labels
texts.label: Labels (comma separated)
texts.default: signed up this month, on the App Store, over the last year, and counting

name: Riffle shuffle
description: A deck of cards cut in two and riffled back together, the cards dropping in from either side in turn before the deck is tapped square, over and over.

name: Cover flow
description: A ring of picture cards turning in perspective, stepping round so each comes to the front in turn, mirrored on a glossy floor.
